text:
maya: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC rename (data-admin -> data-administrators) a handful of SCIM provisioning jobs are failing with KMS decrypt errors. noticed a spike around 02:14 UTC.

sam: ugh. is that tied to the key rotation last week?

jin: looks like it. scim-provisioner is trying to decrypt externalId metadata for service accounts and getting `KMS_DECRYPT_ERR: invalid encryption context` in the logs.

maya: log snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T02:14:33Z scim-provisioner ERROR workspace=acme org=acme-app msg="provision failed" user=svc-account-34 err=KMS_DECRYPT_ERR details="context mismatch: key=alias/redwood-app-2026 ctx={role:data-admin}"
```

alex: that ctx is the old RBAC label. when we rotated the KMS key and rolled the new RBAC naming, the encryption context wasn't updated for stored externalIds. so decrypt fails because context doesn't match.

maya: so current symptom: users/service-accounts can't be mapped to the renamed role during provisioning -> results in missing role grants (seen as 403 in app). impact: onboarding flows and some automated jobs. severity: P2.

sam: can we re-encrypt the stored extids with the new context? do we have the old key to decrypt first?

jin: yes — the old key is in KMS but it was scheduled for rotation. we have access and can use it to decrypt then re-encrypt with the new context. risk: if we do this in prod we must avoid partial states where some extids use old ctx and others new ctx.

alex: plan proposal:
1) run a read-only dry-run job in staging to identify how many entries will be affected.
2) run a transactional re-encrypt job that: decrypts with old key/context -> writes encrypted value using current key/context and marks record with metadata `reencrypted_at` and `reencrypted_by` -> only move to next record on success.
3) hold a short maintenance window for SCIM consumer retries (10m) and route failures to a fallback mapping (email match) during the window.

maya: +1. need audit log entries for every change (who/what/old_ctx/new_ctx). security wants an immutable log. can we emit a per-record audit event to our audit pipeline?

jin: yes — the re-encrypt job will post to audit-ingest with payload: `subject=externalId, id=<id>, old_ctx=<...>, new_ctx=<...>, actor=service:scim-reencrypt, ts=<iso>`. each line will be a single audit event.

sam: what about failure modes? if decryption fails with the old key (key deletion edge-case) we need to abort and escalate. add a pre-check that old key exists and has Decrypt permission for the service account.

alex: also add a guard to throttle writes (rate limit 200/s) and an idempotency key so the job can resume without duplicating work.

maya: timeline? can we do a staging dry-run now and a prod run tonight at 02:00 UTC?

jin: staging dry-run done in ~30m. prod run we should notify SRE to watch error budgets. i'll open a runbook entry.

sam: if anything goes sideways we can roll back by disabling the re-encrypt writer and bring back the old mapping logic (match on unhashed email) for 15m while we investigate. not ideal but gets customers back.

okta-bot: SCIM provisioning webhook retrier detected 129 failed provisioning attempts for org=acme-app in last 60m.

maya: thanks — i'll update the incident tracker (P2) and post to #customers for the limited impact notice.

jin: one more note: there's also a small number (~40) of service-accounts created during the window where the app used the new RBAC name but token metadata was stamped with the old ctx. those will be covered by the re-encrypt job.

alex: after prod run we'll run an audit query: `SELECT id FROM external_ids WHERE reenrypted_at IS NULL AND last_seen > '2026-03-01'` to verify none missed.

maya: action items:
- jin: run staging dry-run and post counts (due +30m)
- alex: prepare re-encrypt job + audit payload format (due +90m)
- sam: schedule prod window and alert SRE (due +2h)
- maya: customer notice + incident doc (due +60m)

sam: thanks. please ping me once staging numbers are in.

jin: staging dry-run results: 1,142 affected extids (most are service accounts), decryption success rate with old key: 100% in staging. posting raw counts to the incident thread.

maya: ok proceeding with prod window at 02:00 UTC. re-encrypt job will run in batches of 500, sleep 1s between batches. will stream audit events.

alex: after re-encrypt we should rotate the audit key and update any infra that relies on `role` ctx. create follow-up ticket to validate all downstream consumers of encryption context.

maya: thanks team — looks like root cause = RBAC rename + KMS context mismatch after rotation. remediation plan approved. closing loop once audit confirms zero failures. :thumbsup:
